view.en: Third-person 3D: a follow camera behind the player, a capped jumper. The HUD shows boss info and a pie-shaped power meter in a corner; arenas are floating platforms with a drop or lava beyond the edges.

goal.en: Defeat the boss (each fight counts differently: hits or lava dunks until zero) to win; you lose when your power meter empties; each fight lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate

mouse.en: Dragging the mouse rotates the camera continuously (double-click the screen to lock it); Q/E turn it 45 degrees at a time and R recenters. The compact actions offer only Q/E/R

keys.en: move forward relative to the camera (full stick)
jump; press again on landing for a double then triple jump; while crouching it is a backflip; during a sharp turn a side flip; held longer jumps higher
crouch; while running it is a slide, then Space is a long jump; in the air it is the slam-down
same as Shift: crouch / slide / mid-air slam-down
punch-punch-kick combo; dive when running fast; flying kick in the air; grabs a grabbable target when close, throws when holding
same as J: attack / grab / throw
snap camera behind you, facing the boss

notes.en: Movement is relative to the camera: W is where the camera faces, so turning the camera changes what each key does
Triple jump, long jump, backflip, side flip and slam-down are available; slam-down is Shift in mid-air and attacks on landing
After being hurt you are briefly invulnerable; falling into lava or a deep drop is a heavy hit
When grabbed, mash Space or flick the stick to break free
A compact packet of 200 ms has 6 sub-steps; punching on a sub-step where the stick is released gives a punch instead of a dive

move.en: stick direction for the whole 200 ms packet (relative to the camera), or a camera turn (Q/E/R); one packet is either movement or a camera turn

options.cam_left: camera turns left 45 degrees (Q), stand still
options.cam_right: camera turns right 45 degrees (E), stand still
options.cam_reset: camera snaps behind you, facing the boss (R), stand still

action.en: action buttons within the packet (punch/grab/throw, jump, slam-down); jump and punch trigger on press

options.jump_hold: jump held for the whole packet (high jump)
options.jump_pound_s2: jump 1 sub-step, then slam-down (Shift) at sub-step 2
options.jump_pound_s3: jump 2 sub-steps, then slam-down (Shift) at sub-step 3

summary.en: On a stone-brick platform you face a huge slab that chases you and topples forward; beyond the edge is a deep drop.

tell.en: The slab stands and walks toward you, speeding up as you get close

effect.en: It only closes in; no contact damage

counter.en: Stay at its front side to lure the jump

tell.en: At close range it stops, rocks back, jumps and falls flat toward you

effect.en: Anyone under the fallen slab is crushed for heavy damage

counter.en: Once it jumps the landing is fixed: run sideways out of its width, or stay in the gap right in front of its feet

tell.en: After the slam it lies still for a second or two; its back is a platform you can stand on

effect.en: This is the only opening

counter.en: Jump onto its back and slam down in the air; jump off before it rises

tell.en: It shakes, then slowly stands up

effect.en: Anyone standing on its back is thrown off

counter.en: Leave its back before it stands

phases.en: On higher tiers it chases faster and lies flat for less time

summary.en: On a grassy hilltop you face a big black iron ball that grabs you; you must grab it from behind and throw it.

tell.en: It walks toward you and keeps turning

effect.en: It tries to grab you once close

counter.en: Circle behind it and avoid standing in front

tell.en: If it touches you while facing you, it lifts you, carries you toward the edge, then throws you

effect.en: You may land off the hilltop; on harder tiers the throw itself hurts

counter.en: While held, mash Space or flick the stick to break free

tell.en: A punch from behind lifts it

effect.en: This starts your counter

counter.en: After lifting it, throw with J so it lands on the hilltop to score; landing off the hill does not count

tell.en: After a hit it shudders, then turns to you

effect.en: Touching it now hurts

counter.en: Wait for the animation to end before approaching

phases.en: On harder tiers it walks and turns faster and the throw hurts more

summary.en: On a small platform over lava you must knock a horned round opponent into the lava; there is no health bar, each lava dunk is one hit.

tell.en: It paces slowly around the platform

effect.en: Switches to chasing when you come close

counter.en: Hold your ground and watch its facing

tell.en: It turns slowly toward you, then dashes suddenly

effect.en: A collision swaps momentum: you are knocked back softly, no damage

counter.en: Hit it with punch, kick, slam-down or land on it to send it flying along your facing toward the lava

tell.en: It slides, then resumes chasing when it slows

effect.en: If you are knocked off the edge you fall into lava and take heavy damage

counter.en: Stand between it and the lava rather than with your back to the edge

summary.en: On a desert plateau two sandstone fists attack in turn; you can hurt them only while a hand is open and its eye is showing.

tell.en: A fist rises high over your position and drops after a pause

effect.en: Being caught under it crushes you for heavy damage

counter.en: Run sideways before it lands

tell.en: A fist slides along the ground to you, then sweeps sideways

effect.en: Being swept to the edge drops you off the plateau

counter.en: Dodge the sweep and stay away from the edge

tell.en: Both fists lift and slam in sequence

effect.en: Wider coverage

counter.en: Slip through the gap between the two

tell.en: After a pound the fist opens to show an eye; it blinks, then closes

effect.en: The only opening

counter.en: Punch or kick the open hand while it is open

phases.en: With one hand down, the other chases you with pushes and slams

summary.en: In a closed square cave room, a segmented crawler that keeps getting faster chases you; only stomping its head works.

tell.en: It crawls around the room, getting faster with each stomp

effect.en: Touching its body or head knocks you away for light damage

counter.en: Keep your distance and wait for its head

tell.en: When its head is stomped it swells, shrinks and goes dazed

effect.en: This is the only effective attack

counter.en: Use a short jump onto the head; a hit counts after the daze ends

tell.en: Before the last hit it hops and sprints

effect.en: Very fast; contact hurts

counter.en: Run in loops and avoid corners

phases.en: Each stomp makes it faster; the last stretch is the fastest

summary.en: On a void octagon you grab a fire-breathing beast by the tail, spin it, and throw it into mines at the platform edge; beyond the edge is a bottomless void.

tell.en: Facing you it lowers its head and spews a line of fireballs

effect.en: Flames burn you, cost health and bounce you up

counter.en: Run out of the line sideways; do not stand in front

tell.en: It crouches, then leaps, landing near you

effect.en: The shockwave hurts if close and stuns if farther

counter.en: Run away before it lands or hop over it

tell.en: It walks toward you and turns

effect.en: Body contact knocks you back and costs health

counter.en: Stay at its side and use the gap when it turns

tell.en: From behind, punch or dive at its tail to grab it, then press W A S D in order to spin faster

effect.en: The faster the spin, the farther the throw

counter.en: Press J toward a mine; a mine hit counts, and the tail is untouchable for a while

tell.en: Occasionally it stomps in place

effect.en: No attack

counter.en: Use it to get behind

phases.en: After a mine hit the tail cannot be grabbed until it recovers
